sourceConsumerReview: Portal settings-modal.js is account recovery UI; no direct subscription-settings/getAllSettings call found in inspected settings-modal.js and onet-modal.js. Broader SDK/external callers still require review.

findings.evidence: SettingsManager.UpdateHyperDriveSettingsAsync reads preferences; UpdateAvatarPreferencesAsync reads full avatar again, edits metadata category and calls SaveAvatarAsync
findings.risk: Concurrent unrelated account/profile/preference fields may be overwritten; source finding requires deterministic native reproduction before claiming loss
findings.next: Pause real native avatar read, commit independent native update, resume actual settings save; require preservation or explicit conflict

findings.evidence: SettingsManager.GetSubscriptionInfoAsync creates active Bronze/card/now+30days and invented limits/counts on missing stored settings; GetSubscriptionSettingsAsync also substitutes those fields
findings.owner: Legacy api/settings/subscription-settings and all-settings aggregate; current SubscriptionController subscriptions/me uses ISubscriptionService and is separate
findings.next: Trace consumers and actual subscription read contract, replace fabricated entitlement values with authoritative service projection; prohibit direct preference writes from changing entitlements

findings.limits: Source inspection is not hosted timing, full Startup, native/browser or reliability acceptance
findings.evidence: Status and metrics controllers read registered provider/config/monitor state, not explicit native data queries; UI polls every30s only while routing panel open and document visible. Delivery GET is separate and defaults limit25 with authenticated avatar filter.

scope: HyperDrive UI status preferences delivery history and legacy settings subscription facade
